article_summaries.title: Spooktacular Returns
article_summaries.summary: Official freerealms.com news post announcing the return of the Halloween Spooktacular event, running October 13 to November 23, 2011. It lists the seasonal world event, a Vampires vs. Werewolves Dance-Off, Halloween quests, Marketplace items, TCG rewards, housing items and outfits. The page gives no exact post date; it shows only 'Posted 4 days, 17 hours ago' relative to capture.

article_summaries.title: Spooktacular Continues and New Rides
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post saying the Halloween Spooktacular event continued with new items in an update. It lists the October Member Pack, a new Bog Shore lot, Halloween housing items, Halloween outfit pieces, and the return of past Halloween Coin Shop items. The post is relative-dated ('6 days, 18 hours ago') against a 2011-10-27 capture, so the exact posting date is approximate (around 2011-10-21).

article_summaries.title: Spooktacular Continues and New Rides
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language freerealms.com news post announcing new Halloween Spooktacular items in a game update: a teaser for new rides, the October Member Pack contents, a new Bog Shore Lot with Halloween housing items, new Halloween outfits, and the return of past Halloween Coin Shop items. The page gives only a relative date ('hace 1 año, 1 semana'), so the exact date is unknown.
